The times appear: Small 1.6875, Lesser 3.375, Standard 6.75, Large 13.5, Grand 27 yurs.

Three further Tech-Mechs are eventually finished; Zoran advances disrupt deliveries, leaving eight additional units unfinished. This is a flash-forward within the historical review, not a claim that all units existed in Year 270.

source_visual_beats.description: She continues knowingly; her eyes become unmistakably WHITE, without a normal iris color. She dies. Her unnamed Temple escort witnesses the death. source_visual_beats.description: In a Temple succession assembly, Seraphine is formally installed as Ashire’s successor in BOTH roles: High Priestess of the Temple of Light and Headmistress of the Academy of Magic. The Temple leadership adopts a new protection rule: the High Priestess is too important to the continuity of the Temple to enter active war zones. Years later, Seraphine may retire from the High Priestess office while continuing as Academy Headmistress; the offices are distinct and can be separated. This is a new rule arising from Ashire’s death, not a restriction she violated. Seraphine pauses before accepting the dual appointment, visibly grieving Ashire; she then inclines her head and accepts the responsibility in silence. No new dialogue.

The first machine was already lost; three survive into Chapter 18.
